messages:
Jordan W: Hey team — seeing short spikes of 502/504 from the ingress gateway affecting /v1/generate between ~10:12–10:18 UTC. Where's the best place to pull the dashboard + recent traces? Should we quiet the alert while we triage?
Maya R: start with the ingress gateway errors dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/d/ingress-gateway/errors (select last 30m, group by upstream_service). Also check 'request-timeouts' dash: https://dash.redwood.com/d/latency/request-timeouts. Those show per-route 5xx breakdown and backend latency distributions.
Maya R: For traces use Honeycomb: https://honeycomb.redwood.com/datasets/requests/table?query=v1%2Fgenerate and filter `http.status_code=502 OR http.status_code=504`. Add `trace_id` to the table and pick 3 samples.
Ben L: adding quick queries you can paste into Datadog logs: `service:ingress-gateway status:[502 TO 504] "v1/generate" @env:prod` — then click the trace link in the log entry.
Ben L: If you want raw request dumps: `kubectl logs -n gateway $(kubectl get pods -n gateway -l app=ingress -o name) --since=20m | grep \"v1/generate\" -n`
Sasha P: Regarding alerts — current prod alert is `ingress.gateway.error_rate > 2% for 5m` (pager). Given these short spikes I'd suggest: 1) mute notif for the noise window OR 2) change to `for: 10m` and add a secondary alert for sustained >1% over 30m. Which do we want?
Jordan W: leaning to option 2 (increase window) so we don't hide actual regressions. Can someone propose the small alert PR?
Maya R: I'll open a tiny PR to adjust the rule and add a runbook pointer. Proposed change: `for: 10m`, keep severity=page for sustained >2% on 10m. Add `ops:eng-platform` as notification.
Maya R: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.com/ingress-5xx (has steps: check backend pool, kv-cache tokens, node OOMs, and how to roll back recent config).
Ben L: For quick triage, sample traces show large backend tail latencies hitting `model-worker` at ~95th pct. Could be temporary queueing. I'll paste one trace id here after grabbing it.
Ben L: example trace id: `trace:b9f3a8c2` — shows 503 returned from `model-worker` with `upstream.connect_timeout` in the logs.
Sasha P: I'll proactively quiet the non-prod pager now (oncall-bot:mute channel non-prod for 30m) so we don't wake folks for staging noise.
oncall-bot: Command accepted — non-prod notifications muted for 30m. :white_check_mark:
Jordan W: thanks — Maya, Ben, can you link the PR here and the three trace ids you pulled? I'll review and merge if it looks safe.
Maya R: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/infra/alerts/commit/ab12c3e — changes `ingress.gateway.error_rate` to 10m window + adds runbook.
Ben L: Traces added to Honeycomb board: `trace:b9f3a8c2`, `trace:c3d5e4f1`, `trace:d7a1b22a`. Notes: all show backend connect spikes at around the same minute.
Jordan W: good info. I'll merge the PR once you both confirm no ongoing spike in the next 15m. If that persists we'll escalate to infra-runbooks and consider throttling ingress burst. :thumbsup:
